_note: Structured content for the home, Research, Resume and Teaching pages. career: roles in chronological order (the phone timeline uses this order); band/col/row place them in the two-row desktop flow on the Resume page; cat is edu, ind, acad or res (industry + academic research); teach adds a teaching badge. milestones: the short career strip on the home page. stats: figures that cannot be counted from other data files (publication, citation and repository counts are computed); top_venues are named on the home publications tile and must each match the short name of at least one paper in publications.json. themes and applications: each item lists the start of one or more publication titles from publications.json; the build links every one to that paper on the Publications page and stops with an error if a title does not match exactly one paper. Projects join an application through their domain in projects.json. Theme figures: img is relative to assets/img/ (svg names a file in assets/svg/); paper links the caption to that publication.
